name: BMW R1250GS
engine: 1254 cc air/liquid-cooled boxer twin, ShiftCam, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: BMW's ShiftCam boxer. Every 2019-2023 bike was in the gearbox input shaft recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. All 2019-2023 R1250GS and GS Adventure bikes are in recall 23V011 for the gearbox input shaft. The fix is new engine control software.
A-002.reason: A broken input shaft can lock the rear wheel. The update is free.

recalls.what: Gearbox input shaft can be damaged or break and lock the rear wheel.
recalls.fix: Dealer updates the engine control software free.
